scope: Any question that names a race, circuit or constructor
description: cl0241 is a reused 'name' column: race name in tb027, circuit name in tb023, constructor name in tb024. Always resolve the name together with its table; 'Chinese Grand Prix' belongs to tb027, 'Silverstone Circuit' to tb023, 'McLaren' to tb024.

scope: Interpreting or comparing race finish times
description: The winner's finish time is a full clock time ('H:MM:SS.mmm'); other classified drivers carry a gap ('+S.mmm'); entries that did not finish may have NULL time. Use cl0272 milliseconds for arithmetic and cl0262 only for display. 'Finished the race' means a non-null finish time.

scope: Resolving a numeric race reference in a question
description: Numbers such as 'race 291' refer to race id cl0259, not the round number cl0260.

scope: Matching a driver named in a question
description: A driver's full name is forename cl0255 followed by surname cl0256. Names in questions must be matched against the concatenation, not against either part alone.

Driver age is computed from date of birth cl0257 against a reference date (current date for present-tense questions). An earlier date of birth means an older driver; a later date of birth means a younger driver.
Pit stop duration cl0274 is decimal text; an average duration is the sum of durations divided by the number of stops. Group by driver before averaging when the question asks for a driver's average.

Q1, Q2 and Q3 times are separate text columns cl0276/cl0277/cl0278. For a driver's Q1 result use cl0276; elimination in the first qualifying period is evaluated within that period's ordering across drivers in the race.

scope: Comparing finishing position with starting position
description: cl0267 is the classified finish position; cl0281 is the starting grid slot. A question about finishing order/ranking uses cl0267; a question about starting in a given track/grid slot uses cl0281.

scope: Resolving card names versus set names
description: cl0137 is a reused 'name' column: card name in tb004, localized card name in tb005, set name in tb007. A set name such as 'Coldsnap' or 'Eighth Edition' must be resolved in tb007; a card name such as 'Ancestor's Chosen' in tb004. A card links to its set via set code (tb004.cl0151 = tb007.cl0169).

Card printings in a language are recorded in tb005 (cl0163 language). Set-name translations live in tb008; a set translation does not by itself establish that a card printing exists in that language. Card availability in a language is a count over tb005 printings, not over tb008.
Power cl0143 is numeric for normal creatures, '*' for variable/infinite power, and NULL for cards without power. 'Infinite power' or 'unknown power' corresponds to '*' or NULL.
Border color values are black, white, gold, silver and borderless. A borderless card is cl0093='borderless'.
Color identity uses the letters W, U, B, R, G and comma-separated combinations (e.g. 'G,W'); NULL means colorless. A 'black card' is a card whose color identity contains B.
Legality status cl0165 is Legal, Banned or Restricted. 'Legal for format X' requires the row for format X (cl0164) with status Legal.
Subtype cl0153 and supertype cl0154 are comma-separated multi-valued lists (e.g. 'Human,Cleric'). Membership tests must account for token boundaries rather than whole-string equality.
cl0166 is the base set size and cl0181 the total set size of a set. A question about a 'base set number/size under N' refers to cl0166.

trigger_keywords: only available outside the United States
description: cl0171=1 means the set was available only outside the United States; 0 means it was not restricted to outside the US.

cl0094 and cl0095 are sparse print identifiers present on subsets of cards (both present 25,061; only one present 21,990; neither 9,771). In the supplied workload the 'foil / incredibly powerful' condition corresponds to both identifiers being present. They are identifiers, not counts.
Oracle text cl0156 contains ability wording. Phrase searches should be case-insensitive and may match localized variants in tb005.cl0156.
Bond type symbols are '-' single, '=' double, '#' triple.
cl0420 is '+' for carcinogenic and '-' for non-carcinogenic molecules.

scope: Resolving an atom within a molecule
description: Atom ids have the form <moleculeId>_<atomIndex> (e.g. TR009_12). The molecule is the prefix before the underscore and the atom index follows it. A bond id has the form <moleculeId>_<atomA>_<atomB>.
An atom's connections appear in tb059 with the atom in either endpoint column (cl0414 or cl0419). An atom with no row in either endpoint cannot bond with any other atom.

Clinical examinations (tb054) and laboratory panels (tb056) are separate event streams, both keyed by patient cl0353 and a date. Laboratory measurements exist only in tb056; symptoms and thrombosis degree exist only in tb054.
cl0365 degree 0 means no thrombosis; 1-3 are increasing severity. 'Severe' and 'most serious' refer to the highest non-zero degrees present.
Patient sex cl0366 is 'F' for female and 'M' for male; a small number of rows have an empty value.

Anti-SM cl0407 mixes textual and numeric tokens: 'negative' is negative, '0' is equivocal (+-), and numeric values >=1 are positive; NULL means not tested. Do not treat it as a continuous numeric measurement.
Uric acid normality is sex-specific: values up to 8.0 are treated as normal for males and up to 6.5 for females; higher values are abnormal. Join patient sex when applying the threshold.

Widely used thresholds in this workload: LDH above 500 is beyond normal; red blood cell count below 3.5 is low; hematocrit >= 52 is above normal; prothrombin time >= 14 is abnormal. Apply these as stated in the question when different cutoffs are given.
Normal IgA is defined as values between 80 and 500 inclusive; lower or higher values are outside the normal range.
Patient age is computed from birthday cl0367 against a reference date (current date for present-tense questions). Age at an examination date uses that examination date as reference.
Diagnosis text may contain multiple comma-separated diseases and a 'susp' qualifier (e.g. 'SLE, SJS', 'RA susp.'). Match disease tokens, not the whole string.

District type code cl0065 and text cl0066 are paired: 52 Elementary School District, 54 Unified School District, 60 High School District, 00 County Office of Education, 56 Regional Occupation Center/Program, 98 State Board of Education, and others. Use cl0065 for codes and cl0066 for human-readable labels.

cl0062 charter flag: 1 chartered, 0 non-chartered, NULL unknown. cl0075 virtual flag: N not virtual, P partially virtual, F exclusively virtual (so no physical building). cl0043 status: Active, Closed, Merged, Pending.

Free-meal rate = free meal count / K-12 enrollment; FRPM rate = FRPM count / K-12 enrollment. The stored cl0021 and cl0023 columns are fractions (0-1), while questions often state a percentage; convert consistently.

SAT average columns are school-level or district-level averages. An 'average of average math score' is the sum of the school-level averages divided by the number of schools unless a weighted average is explicitly requested. Do not mix record types S and D in one average.

scope: Joining school, FRPM and SAT records
description: The CDS code (tb003.cl0001, tb001.cl0001, tb002.cl0030) is the school identifier. Codes are fixed-width text and compare directly; join on the code rather than on school name.
Event status cl0294 and budget status tb040.cl0311 both use Open, Closed and Planning.
In tb040, cl0310 is the budgeted amount, cl0308 the spent amount and cl0309 the remaining amount. Spend-to-budget ratio = cl0308 / cl0310. The budget amount is not cl0308.
Expense approval cl0316 is the text 'true' when approved and NULL otherwise.
Attendance per event is the number of event-member rows in tb039 for that event (cl0304). An event with no rows has attendance zero.

scope: Matching a member named in a question
description: Member full name is first name cl0322 followed by last name cl0323. Match names against the concatenation.
Gender values are Male/Female; alignment values are Good, Bad, Neutral and N/A. Villains are alignment 'Bad'.

The single colour lookup (tb046.cl0333) serves three different hero attributes: eye colour via tb050.cl0340, hair colour via tb050.cl0341 and skin colour via tb050.cl0342. Join through the intended attribute; 'green-skinned' uses the skin link, while 'no eye colour' uses the eye link.
Superhero attribute values range from 5 to 100. Height cl0346 is in centimetres and weight cl0347 in kilograms.
Publisher names are stored verbatim (25 distinct values), including 'Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics', 'Dark Horse Comics' and 'Star Trek'. Publisher id is tb048.cl0330.
Station country cl0189 uses CZE for the Czech Republic and SVK for Slovakia. Customer payment currency cl0186 uses CZK or EUR.

scope: Segment filtering across customers and stations
description: cl0185 holds two different vocabularies: customer segments SME/LAM/KAM in tb010 and station segments Discount/Noname/Other/Premium/Value for money in tb011. Resolve the segment together with the table.
Year-month cl0193 is text 'YYYYMM' (e.g. 201202). For a whole year, filter the four-character year prefix; for a month, filter the exact six-character value.

In tb013, cl0196 is the quantity/amount of product and cl0197 is the total price paid. Spending sums cl0197; volume sums cl0196; unit price is cl0197 divided by cl0196. Time is cl0194 (HH:MM:SS) and date cl0193 (YYYY-MM-DD).
Loan status A/B/C/D: C and D are still-running contracts, and D means the client is in debt; A and B are finished contracts.

cl0205 is a reused 'type' column: card type classic/junior/gold in tb016, disposition type OWNER/DISPONENT in tb018, and transaction type PRIJEM/VYDAJ/VYBER in tb022. 'High-level credit card' means card type gold; 'eligible for loans' corresponds to disposition type OWNER. Always qualify by table.
Frequency codes: POPLATEK MESICNE = monthly statement, POPLATEK TYDNE = weekly statement, POPLATEK PO OBRATU = issuance after each transaction.

cl0205 transaction type: PRIJEM credit, VYDAJ debit, VYBER withdrawal. Operation cl0235 'VYBER KARTOU' means credit-card withdrawal; other operations include VKLAD (deposit), PREVOD NA UCET and PREVOD Z UCTU (transfers).

District measures: cl0212 inhabitants, cl0219 average salary, cl0220 unemployment rate 1995 and cl0221 unemployment rate 1996, cl0223 crimes 1995 and cl0224 crimes 1996. Unemployment increment percentage = (cl0221 - cl0220) / cl0220 * 100. Region names live in cl0211 and district names in cl0210.
Branch/location references the district id cl0200 on the account; district 1 is Hl.m. Praha (Prague).

scope: Any time an opaque cl column is resolved
description: Opaque cl identifiers are not globally unique in meaning. Examples: cl0205 = card type / disposition type / transaction type; cl0137 = card name / localized card name / set name; cl0241 = circuit / constructor / race name; cl0226 = loan / order / transaction amount; cl0185 = customer / station segment. Resolve a column only together with its table and verify its value domain.
